    AI Overview
    Charles Lee is the head coach of the Charlotte Hornets, taking the position in May 2024. He came to Charlotte after serving as a top assistant coach with the Boston Celtics and Milwaukee Bucks. Lee is recognized for his developmental focus and previously played in the NBA's Patriot League. 
    Key Details About Coach Charles Lee: 
    • Role: Head Coach, Charlotte Hornets (2024–present).
    • Background: Former assistant coach for the Boston Celtics (2023–24) and Milwaukee Bucks (2018–2023).
    • Playing Career:
      Starred at Bucknell University and played in the NBA's Patriot League.
       
    Before joining the Hornets, Lee was a highly regarded assistant who won an NBA championship with the Milwaukee Bucks in 2021.
